descricao_original: This complex stain utilizes five dyes to reveal the different components of tissue. With this stain, elastic fibers stain black; collagen and reticular fibers stain yellow; tissue ground substance stains blue; and cytoplasm stains red. This section of skin demonstrates this dramatic staining pattern. 200x
